prompt: Create an original 60 second lo-fi instrumental hip hop instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: Rhodes piano, muted drums, warm bass. Style: laid-back swung beat and hazy jazz harmony. Tempo approximately 90 BPM; C major. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A smooth and sophisticated instrumental piece featuring a piano melody over a steady bassline and light drum rhythm. It has a relaxed, jazzy feel.
description.zh: 一段流畅而精致的器乐作品，以钢琴旋律为主，配以稳定的贝斯线和轻快的鼓点。它带有一种轻松、爵士的氛围。
